notes.title: COMPLETE OVERHAUL OF THE MONSTER WAR
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EHHUFP8xmLw;full][/previewyoutube]

A total overhaul to the game, from graphics to controls and level design.

Finally the game looks like what I had originally envisioned. 

The experience has been cut down significantly in order to make it more manageable. It is a short gameplay experience, maybe 10 to 20 minutes, but it is fully polished now and ready for you to play to your hearts content.

This game was always meant to be something fun that children could play for free without worry of difficulty, microtransactions, or save progress. Something you can put in front of a 6 year old and let them enjoy without having to worry.

I hope you enjoy the new look and feel to the game! Please leave a review if you do. 

I will consider making more content for the game in the future if there is a demand for it. Otherwise, this will be the "final version" of The Monster War.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE! Complete overhaul of the game
notes.content:
There's more patch notes than I can provide right now. I wasn't prepared to provide a big list lol but basically I fixed everything and replaced all of the meshes so that it is no longer going for that "realistic" fantasy look but instead is very cartoonish and childlike as the game is meant for children.

Hope you enjoy, I think it's SO much better!
